title: US Republicans warn Australia of ‘punitive measures’ over recognition of Palestinian state
summary: Donald Trump allies, including Ted Cruz, pen letter warning Anthony Albanese against ‘reckless policy’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Anthony Albanese says he will push for improved global peace and security during meetings with world leaders this week, as allies of Donald Trump warn Australia’s recognition of Palestine could spark “punitive measures” from the US.
